name: HTML Entity Codec
description: Convert between text and HTML entities, covering named and numeric forms.

hints.input: Escaping handles the five characters & < > " and the single quote.

faq.q: How does this differ from the HTML formatter?
faq.a: The formatter handles whole HTML documents; this tool only deals with the entity layer.
No. Escaping is only one layer; pair it with context-aware output and sanitisation.
